newsitem.title: USA: Calif. sells $45 mln of refunding bonds - Treasurer.
newsitem.headline: Calif. sells $45 mln of refunding bonds - Treasurer.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong said on Tuesday he sold $45 million in public works board refunding bonds to lower debt service costs.
The sale of the lease revenue refunding bonds for the Department of Corrections will save taxpayers about $1.77 million in lower debt service payments, Fong said.
The proceeds of the sale will refund Department of Corrections 991 Series A bonds, used to fund construction of a state prison in Imperial County.

The sale earned a true interest cost of 5.499037. The bonds were sold in a negotiated sale by a team lead by senior underwriter Bear Stearns & Co Inc. The bonds were partially insured by MBIA Insurance Corp.
